title: Perfect for craft storage/organization
text: Perfect for craft storage/organization. This set was perfect for my craft storage from beads to my sewing parts.  They are small enough and not too deep to keep everything easy to access.  The plastic thickness is perfect with a tiny give if you press really hard. The lids snap on tightly and are all good fit.  The lids imprint that they are safe for microwave and dishwasher, I am not testing either as I can’t belief the heat for dishwasher doesn’t have some negative effect all round.  I am super happy as I am so much more organized and see where everything is.
